scope: Final candidate: native processing/energy circuits, inventory transactions and codec/factories
limitations: Owned IC2 gameplay fixtures, multiplayer clients and endurance server closed before the first fork. The user game and unrelated services are left untouched; background process counts are recorded per fork. Balanced order, exact frozen artifacts and separate JVM forks retained. Native isolated server workloads do not measure full-modpack FPS.
Registry fingerprints include renamed Java classes. Native geometry, transaction counts and checksums match exactly.
Protocol 2 differs from alpha.10; all five compiled benchmark fixtures have identical instructions after only documented symbol/constant-pool normalization.
This compares only the stated native workloads. Whole-project completion also requires exact-artifact gameplay and endurance acceptance.

method.circuit: one generator, four cables, one upgraded macerator
